motion: President Kennedy was assassinated by a conspiracy involving elements of the US government, not by a lone gunman.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: CA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: The Warren Commission report is flawed and doesn't provide a complete picture of the events surrounding JFK's assassination.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: This statement challenged the widely accepted findings and sparked further discussion on potential conspiracy theories.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: SA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: The weight of evidence supports the conclusion that Lee Harvey Oswald acted alone in assassinating President Kennedy.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: This statement provided a counterargument and reinforced the official narrative.

outcome_summary: The debate concluded with no clear consensus on the topic.
limitations: Insufficient time for comprehensive discussion on all aspects of the topic.
Lack of concrete evidence to definitively prove or disprove conspiracy theories.
